criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Penalty: the program carries graded values of the shipped cycle as literals.

criteria.name: negative_file_access_outside_run_paths
criteria.description: Penalty: a run reads or writes files outside its extract and output directories.

criteria.name: negative_third_party_import
criteria.description: Penalty: the program imports a module outside the Python standard library.

criteria.name: negative_network_or_process
criteria.description: Penalty: the program imports a network module, opens a socket or starts another process.

criteria.name: negative_location_dependent_output
criteria.description: Penalty: the reports change when the extract, output and working directories move.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: Penalty: two runs on the same extract at the same paths give different bytes.
